# kion_label (Resource)

Manages a Kion Label.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_label" "example" {
  # Required
  color = "example"
  key   = "example"
  value = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (String) Hex value of the label color
- `key` (String) Key of the label (first part of the label)
- `value` (String) Value of the label (second part of the label following the key)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the label.
